title: Israeli tanks launch first ground push since ceasefire near Bureij and Nuseirat; 3 Palestinians killed
detail: Israeli forces launched a ground operation with tanks in central Gaza near the Al-Bureij and Nuseirat refugee camps, halting traffic on Salah al-Din road. Hospital officials said three Palestinians were killed and many residents fled. The IDF called it a precise operation to dismantle a tunnel west of the Yellow Line posing a direct threat to troops; Hamas called it a flagrant ceasefire violation. Al Jazeera described it as the first ground push since the October 2025 ceasefire began.

media.caption: Palestinians flee refugee camp as Israel begins operation in central Gaza

confidenceReason: Multiple outlets (Al Jazeera, Euronews, Middle East Eye) report the operation; IDF statement on its purpose
